_about: THE SWITCH (WORDS THREE 11/20; VAMILY rules 454(a)(d), 455, 461). A mouth of the game is rewritten to THE VOICE (laws/BOHEMIA_LAW_THE_VOICE_11_17_26.md) ONLY after Paolo says go for it. 'open' gets one entry per mouth he says go for: {"mouth": one of the 15 in records/words_two/the_voice_freeze.json, "said": HIS words, exactly, "from": the VOTE card id his note is on, or the record that holds his words, "date": "m/d"}. A lane never types a go for him; gates/the_voice_holds_gate.py checks each one against where it says he said it. 'let_go' is for a standing line of a CLOSED mouth that changed for a reason that is not a rewrite (cut to fit a length cap under rule 355(a), its feature deleted): {"mouth", "line" (the frozen line, exactly), "why", "by"}. Both are empty: nothing is open, nothing has been let go.
